name: elbow flexor stretch
description: Extending your arm and turning the palm outward stretches the muscles that bend your elbow. It targets the biceps and brachialis.
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with your palm facing up.
Use your other hand to gently press the fingers down and back until you feel the stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
